feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 26 May 2026 3:34pm
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

Variable 1 to 3, settling North or NW 3 or 4 this morning, then occasionally 5 to the west of the island later in afternoon and evening. Then gradually veering East 4 or 5 in all waters tonight.


##State of sea)##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later today and tonight.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 20°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

East 4 or 5 through morning and afternoon, increasing East or SE 5 or 6 during the evening and at first overnight, possibly occasionally 7 to west of the island.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair, risk of showers developing overnight.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Thursday, 28 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

East or SE 5 or 6 at first, possibly occasionally 7 to west of island, but veering and decreasing South or SE 4 or 5 through day, then veering South or SW overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Showers at first, risk of mist or fog patches later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate at first, poor or very poor in any mist/fog patches.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Friday, 29 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

South or SW 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Saturday, 30 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

SW 3 or 4, backing South or SW 4 or 5 later in day, veering West overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain for a time.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
